integrity: The proof uses the exact affine law of a uniform simplex conditioned on a minimum-coordinate threshold, majorization for the sign theorem, and Dirichlet/Beta moments for the closed formulas. Independent exact low-dimensional simplex integration is included in the checker.
scientific_limitations: The exact affine conditioning law assumes the uniform Dirichlet spacing vector.
The sign theorem covers all real powers a>0, while the closed covariance formula is stated for integer powers.
Equivalent mixed moments may exist in older spacings or Dirichlet order-statistic literature under different notation.
title: Minimum spacing flips covariance at the power-one boundary
